```{r}
#| label: setup
source(here::here("R", "functions.R"))
source(here::here("R", "plot_functions.R"))
source(here::here("R", "card_functions.R"))

db_dir     <- here::here("data", "processed")
stocks     <- readr::read_csv(file.path(db_dir, "stocks.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
timeseries <- readr::read_csv(file.path(db_dir, "timeseries.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

s <- make_card_data(stocks, timeseries) |> filter(stock_id == params$stock_id)
md_escape <- function(x) str_replace_all(x, "([*_#|])", "\\\\\\1")
```

::: {.disclaimer}
Exploratory personal project. Not an official assessment and not a seafood recommendation.

## Management context

```{r}
#| label: management
#| results: asis
# DFO text is shown in quotation marks, exactly as published
q <- function(x) if (is.na(x)) "Not reported" else paste0("\u201c", md_escape(x), "\u201d")
mgmt <- c(
  glue("**Limit reference point, as described by DFO:** {q(s$lrp_description)}"),
  glue("**Upper stock reference, as described by DFO:** {q(s$usr_description)}"),
  glue("**Limit used for this project's indicator:** {md_escape(coalesce(s$lrp_basis, 'None (no time series compiled)'))}"),
  glue("**Management plan, as reported by DFO:** {q(s$ifmp)}"),
  glue("**Managed by:** {md_escape(s$manager)}")
)
cat("\nText in quotation marks is copied exactly as published in DFO's 2024 Sustainability Survey for Fisheries, including any typos.\n\n")
cat(paste0("- ", mgmt), sep = "\n")

links <- str_extract_all(coalesce(s$science_report_links, ""), "https?://\\S+")[[1]]
if (length(links) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n**Science documents cited by DFO in the 2024 survey:**\n\n")
  cat(paste0("- <", links, ">"), sep = "\n")
}
```
